## Topics

### Family-of-Origin Structure and Parental Relationship
Description of the Irish Catholic family diagram, including six siblings, parental marriage dynamics, alcohol use, and the mother's verbal and physical aggression toward the father.
*_(~20% of transcript; Sections 1-2)_*

### Client's Psychiatric Hospitalizations in the 1970s
Account of two inpatient psychiatric admissions following high school, including the client's experience of catatonia, one delusional episode, and his self-directed discharge from the second hospitalization.
*_(~15% of transcript; Sections 7-8)_*

### Client's Educational and Career Recovery
The client's trajectory from post-hospitalization unemployment through community college, BSW, MSW, and a full career in psychiatric mental health, culminating in retirement in 2015.
*_(~10% of transcript; Sections 9)_*

### Marriage, Divorce, and Co-Parenting History
Overview of the client's marriage beginning in 1985, the breakdown of the relationship after their daughter's birth, divorce by the early 1990s, and his sustained active involvement in his daughter's upbringing including addressing her abuse by her mother and stepfather.
*_(~15% of transcript; Sections 10-11)_*

### Daughter's Functioning, Dependency Concerns, and Current Life
The presenting concern driving the therapy: the daughter's susceptibility to others' opinions, her work in fashion, the client's financial boundaries with her, her OCD symptoms, and her current relationship with a boyfriend in Baltimore.
*_(~25% of transcript; Sections 3-5, 12)_*

### Client's Recent Physical Health Decline
The client's experience of bone loss, jaw surgery, bone graft complications, resulting neuropathy, paralyzed vocal cord, and swallowing difficulties, described as having destabilized him.
*_(~5% of transcript; Section 13)_*
